network_response.universal: h=log10(b)+log10(K); shift acts through A[:,ihub], not all observations
network_response.cepheid: E[y_i]=mu_host+c_i*delta_C for explicitly admitted differential module bias; elementary measurements/anchors determine response before compression
network_response.common_zero_point: may cancel host versus anchor; do not equate to differential delta_C
network_response.identifiability: universal shift degenerate with free h in local-only network; independent background and nuisance-projected rank required
network_response.catalog_scope: H0DN baseline excludes JAGB; F1 requires TRGB/JAGB test, so baseline-only H0DN does not fulfill that item; specify augmented source/selection and shared covariance before use

singular_covariance.support: N.T @ residual == 0 under fixed rank/units convention, plus residual.T C_pinv residual
singular_covariance.latent_network: prefer covariance and physical responses transported from elementary measurements through same B
singular_covariance.normalization: pseudo-determinant and support measure kept; unlike-dimensional support densities not comparable without common observation model
singular_covariance.numerics: IDL relative tolerance and Python absolute atol=1e-10 differ; qualify a fixed unit-aware rule before new model comparison

prior_transport_proposal.restricted_example: pure Cepheid ladder, other intercept/geometry fixed; positive delta_C is bias in published distance modulus
prior_transport_proposal.not_for_mixed_network: mixed network response must be computed from actual elementary equations; not apply pure ladder factor to compressed total
prior_transport_proposal.choice: keep original proposed uniform-s prior via Jacobian, or choose a different physical prior explicitly before data; neither ratified
